semantic_reason: The PR directly addresses issue #367, which reports a performance problem: the Janitor service, enabled by default, runs a costly transaction lock every few seconds even when no expirations exist. The changes (lazy Janitor initialization, skipping purge cycles until expirations are detected, and removing table lookups via Cachex.Provision) correct this existing undesirable behavior and overhead. This is a defect/performance bug fix rather than a new feature, even though it includes refactoring and added internal support.
